answer: Identities lock 70 credits in a vault, committing a hash of their tundra plot and key. The vault releases its nonce after commits close; no sonnet is composed early. At reveal, auditors recompute each sonnet from the tundra registry and vault nonce; wrong, late, or doubled sonnets burn the bond; rented verses fail. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000, pool 40,000. Honest identities pay 38 once, reclaiming it after a clean epoch.
